name: heimster-pro
description: The Heimster Pro workspace for Swiss real-estate agencies: listings, applications, viewings, owners, CRM and investment properties – within your organisation and role.

interface.longDescription:
Heimster Pro is the workspace of Swiss real-estate agencies – properties, listings, applications, viewings, CRM contacts, owners, new-build projects and investment properties. This app lets agents work with it in plain language, inside their own organisation and with their own permissions.

What you can ask:
• Daily work: "What's on today?", "Which listings need attention?", "Which e-mails still need a reply?"
• Lettings: rank the applicants for a flat by the Heimster score, check what is missing in a dossier, see where decisions are pending.
• Sales: the evidence-based selling points of a property, interested parties ranked by fit, the anonymous network demand.
• Owners: which owners to call this week (ready to sell, mandates ending, follow-ups due), owner reports and recurring report subscriptions.
• Investment properties: yield figures from the rent roll, the bidding process, the investor funnel and matching investors from the CRM.
• Marketing: social-post drafts from verified facts, mailing audiences with consent check, exposé dispatch plans, portal export preview and sync health.
• CRM: create and update contacts, log activities and follow-ups, draft e-mails into Outlook.

Safety built in: only members of a Heimster Pro organisation can connect, and the assistant acts within the signed-in user's organisation and role (read-only users can't change anything). E-mails, mailings and social posts are saved as drafts. Anything with an effect outside the organisation – price changes, owner reports, pre-market alerts, calendar invitations, applicant notifications, new viewings, publishing a listing – first returns a preview and only runs after an explicit confirmation.

Details and the full tool list: heimster.ch/developers/pro-ai. Privacy: heimster.ch/privacy#ki-assistenten-pro

positive.description: Daily overview of the signed-in agent's organisation.
positive.prompt: What's on today, and which of my listings need attention?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls daily_overview and portfolio_status for the demo organisation; lists today's viewing at Seestrasse 12, the newest applications, and flags «Bright 3.5-room flat near the lake» (about 30 days online, few applications).

positive.description: Rank applicants for a rental listing.
positive.prompt: Rank the applicants for the family flat on Bergstrasse 45 in Zurich.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the listing with list_my_listings, calls rank_applicants and returns the applicants sorted by Heimster score (Mira Odermatt highest), with their status.

positive.prompt: Which owners should I call this week?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls owner_radar; lists Thomas Brunner (ready to sell, exclusive mandate ending) and Elena Rossi (follow-up due today) with the reasons.

positive.prompt: How is the bidding for MFH Zürcherstrasse 88 going, and which investors from my CRM could we still invite?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the binding bid of CHF 6.75 m and the indicative bid of CHF 6.4 m against the price anchor, and suggests Martina Kunz (Zürisee Pensionskasse) as a matching investor not yet invited.

positive.description: A price change is previewed and needs explicit confirmation.
positive.prompt: Lower the rent of the flat at Seestrasse 12 to CHF 3,300.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls change_price without a confirmation token first and shows the preview (old and new price, who would be notified) and asks the user to confirm; only a second call with the returned token changes the price.

negative.description: A home-seeker request – not an agency workspace task.
negative.prompt: Find me a 3-room flat to rent in Zurich.
What will the weather be like in Zurich tomorrow?

negative.description: General knowledge without any agency data.
negative.prompt: Explain how a Swiss mortgage works.

publication.release_notes: First release: Heimster Pro workspace in ChatGPT – daily overview, applicants, owners, selling points, investment properties, marketing drafts and CRM, with two-step confirmation for outbound actions.

de-DE.subtitle: Arbeitsbereich für Makler
de-DE.description:
Heimster Pro ist der Arbeitsbereich von Schweizer Immobilienfirmen – Objekte, Inserate, Bewerbungen, Besichtigungen, CRM-Kontakte, Eigentümerschaften, Neubauprojekte und Anlageobjekte. Mit dieser App arbeiten Maklerinnen und Makler in natürlicher Sprache damit – innerhalb ihrer Organisation und mit ihren eigenen Berechtigungen.

Was Sie fragen können:
• Tagesgeschäft: «Was steht heute an?», «Welche Inserate brauchen Aufmerksamkeit?», «Welche E-Mails sind noch offen?»
• Vermietung: Bewerbungen nach Heimster-Score ordnen, fehlende Dossier-Unterlagen erkennen, offene Entscheide sehen.
• Verkauf: belegte Verkaufsargumente, Interessenten nach Passung, anonyme Netzwerk-Nachfrage.
• Eigentümer: wen Sie diese Woche anrufen sollten (verkaufsbereit, Mandat läuft aus, Wiedervorlage fällig), Eigentümer-Reports und Report-Abos.
• Anlageobjekte: Rendite aus dem Mietzinsspiegel, Bieterverfahren, Investoren-Funnel und passende Investoren aus dem CRM.
• Marketing: Social-Entwürfe aus verifizierten Fakten, Mailing-Zielgruppen mit Einwilligungsprüfung, Exposé-Versandplan, Portal-Vorschau und -Status.
• CRM: Kontakte anlegen und ändern, Aktivitäten und Wiedervorlagen erfassen, E-Mail-Entwürfe in Outlook.

Sicherheit eingebaut: Nur Mitglieder einer Heimster-Pro-Organisation können sich verbinden; der Assistent handelt im Rahmen der Organisation und Rolle des angemeldeten Kontos. E-Mails, Mailings und Social-Beiträge entstehen als Entwürfe. Alles mit Wirkung nach aussen – Preisänderungen, Eigentümer-Reports, Vorpremieren, Kalendereinladungen, Benachrichtigungen an Bewerbende, neue Besichtigungen, Veröffentlichungen – zeigt zuerst eine Vorschau und läuft erst nach Ihrer ausdrücklichen Bestätigung.

Details: heimster.ch/developers/pro-ai · Datenschutz: heimster.ch/privacy#ki-assistenten-pro

fr-FR.subtitle: Espace pour courtiers
fr-FR.description:
Heimster Pro est l’espace de travail des agences immobilières suisses – biens, annonces, candidatures, visites, contacts CRM, propriétaires, projets neufs et immeubles de rendement. Cette app permet aux courtiers d’y travailler en langage naturel, dans leur propre organisation et avec leurs propres droits.

Ce que vous pouvez demander :
• Quotidien : « Qu’est-ce qui est prévu aujourd’hui ? », « Quelles annonces demandent de l’attention ? », « Quels e-mails attendent une réponse ? »
• Location : classer les candidatures selon le score Heimster, voir ce qui manque dans un dossier, repérer les décisions en attente.
• Vente : arguments de vente fondés sur des faits, personnes intéressées par adéquation, demande anonyme du réseau.
• Propriétaires : qui appeler cette semaine, rapports aux propriétaires et abonnements de rapports.
• Immeubles de rendement : rendement selon l’état locatif, procédure d’offres, entonnoir des investisseurs et investisseurs adaptés du CRM.
• Marketing : brouillons de publications à partir de faits vérifiés, audiences de mailing avec contrôle du consentement, plan d’envoi d’exposés, aperçu et état des portails.
• CRM : créer et modifier des contacts, saisir activités et relances, brouillons d’e-mails dans Outlook.

Sécurité intégrée : seuls les membres d’une organisation Heimster Pro peuvent se connecter ; l’assistant agit dans le cadre de l’organisation et du rôle du compte connecté. Tout ce qui a un effet à l’extérieur ne s’exécute qu’après un aperçu et une confirmation explicite.

Détails : heimster.ch/developers/pro-ai · Protection des données : heimster.ch/privacy#ki-assistenten-pro

it-IT.subtitle: Spazio di lavoro per agenti
it-IT.description:
Heimster Pro è lo spazio di lavoro delle agenzie immobiliari svizzere – immobili, annunci, candidature, visite, contatti CRM, proprietari, nuove costruzioni e immobili a reddito. Con questa app gli agenti ci lavorano in linguaggio naturale, nella propria organizzazione e con i propri permessi.

Cosa può chiedere:
• Quotidiano: «Cosa c’è oggi?», «Quali annunci richiedono attenzione?», «Quali e-mail attendono una risposta?»
• Locazione: ordinare le candidature secondo il punteggio Heimster, vedere cosa manca in un dossier, individuare le decisioni in sospeso.
• Vendita: argomenti di vendita basati su fatti, interessati per affinità, domanda anonima della rete.
• Proprietari: chi chiamare questa settimana, rapporti ai proprietari e abbonamenti ai rapporti.
• Immobili a reddito: rendimento dallo stato locativo, procedura di offerta, funnel degli investitori e investitori adatti dal CRM.
• Marketing: bozze di post da fatti verificati, destinatari di mailing con verifica del consenso, piano d’invio degli esposé, anteprima e stato dei portali.
• CRM: creare e modificare contatti, registrare attività e promemoria, bozze di e-mail in Outlook.

Sicurezza integrata: solo i membri di un’organizzazione Heimster Pro possono collegarsi; l’assistente agisce nell’ambito dell’organizzazione e del ruolo dell’account. Tutto ciò che ha effetti all’esterno viene eseguito solo dopo un’anteprima e una conferma esplicita.

Dettagli: heimster.ch/developers/pro-ai · Protezione dei dati: heimster.ch/privacy#ki-assistenten-pro
